overall: Tomorrow (June 19) in Atlanta is expected to be a warm early-summer day with high temperatures likely in the low-to-mid 80s°F. The observation-adjusted ensemble is pulling the forecast notably lower than pure model output, suggesting today's cooler-than-expected readings (max 77°F) are tempering the outlook. Conditions appear seasonably warm but not extreme.

Best estimate is approximately 80°F, acknowledging the obs-adjustment but respecting the NWP model consensus; uncertainty is high and betting signals are weak.
